chunks: And through his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The majority of the people of Hell are the proud.

key_terms.الْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ: The proud / Those who are arrogant

ai.seo_question: Who are the majority of the people of Hell according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to emphasize that arrogance (*al-kibr*) is not merely a character flaw but the dominant trait of Hell's inhabitants, distinguishing it from other sins. This aligns with the Shia understanding of *al-kibr* as the root of all sins, mirroring Iblis's refusal to prostrate to Adam, thereby marking it as a fundamental rejection of divine authority.
